name: Cồn Phụng
kicker: Orchard islet of the Coconut Monk on the Tiền
summary: A river day on the Tiền, on the orchard where the Coconut Monk built the nine-dragon court. Go when the palms and the kiln are why you came. Skip it when you only wanted the lake walk in town. The gate is check on arrival.
getThere: 12 km by road and 25 km by river, or about 10 km. The town pier is a different landing.
heroCaption: The nine-dragon court, with the tower behind it

notice.title: This is not cù lao Thới Sơn
notice.body: The town orchard pier is a different landing, and the Friday town cart does not reach this islet.

body: Walk the ground of Đạo Dừa: Tòa Bảo tháp, Sân Rồng with nine dragons for the nine Mekong mouths, and Cửu Trùng đài. The national rural page places the islet in xã Tân Thạch, huyện Châu Thành, over 50 ha, 12 km by road and 25 km by river from the city center. The operator page prints about 10 km, and the address ấp 10 (Ấp Tân Vinh), xã Phú Túc, tỉnh Vĩnh Long. Clause 59 of Nghị quyết 1687/NQ-UBTVQH15 merges thị trấn Châu Thành and the communes Tân Thạch, Tường Đa, and Phú Túc into xã Phú Túc. Ask for either name. The clause does not say the islet moved.

On the same ground you can see coconut candy, rice paper, more than 500 shell-craft objects, honey tea, đờn ca tài tử, a horse cart under the palms, and a sampan in a nipa creek. A stage time for the music was not printed. Check on arrival. No minute count was printed, so plan a river day. The four nicknames are Long, Lân, Quy, and Phụng. Lân has no bank named. This landing is not the town boat at bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre.

figures.caption: Tourist boats at the Cồn Phụng landing on the Tiền
figures.alt: Wooden tourist boats tied at the Cồn Phụng landing on the Tiền

gettingThere: The national rural page prints 12 km by road and 25 km by river from the city center. The operator page prints about 10 km. Both figures stand. A fare was not printed. Check on arrival. The Friday seven-seat cart in town is not the way onto the islet.

legs.heading: From Ben Tre
legs.body: By road or by river. The rural page prints 12 km by road and 25 km by river. The operator page prints about 10 km. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival. The town orchard boat uses bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre, a different landing.

hours: The operator page prints 07:30–18:00. The national rural page prints no hours.
closed: No weekly close was printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: The operator page prints a gate of 50,000 VND for an adult and 30,000 VND for a child, and an ecology tour at 149,000 VND. It does not print an age or a height for the child price. The national rural page prints no tariff. The fee is Check on arrival. Do not treat the operator figures as the only price.
